rules: Every module uses the canonical Palta app shell and API boundary.
Do not create a module-specific canonical database when the platform Postgres is the owner.
Direct R2/edge reads are allowed only for approved public/static high-volume data.
Private mutations and business operations go through authenticated Palta API.
Provider credentials and privileged provider calls remain server-side.
Money/fiscal operations use transactional Postgres plus Durable Outbox.
Device SQLite is cache/offline journal only, never global canonical truth.

identity_profile.notes: Supabase Auth proves identity; Palta Postgres roles/capabilities decide authorization.

home.notes: Home is a projection/composition surface, not a parallel content database.

local_business.notes: Canonical business is reused by map/search/detail/commerce/care. Public snapshots may be edge-cached.

community.notes: Private school/class/community authorization is server-enforced; media does not make R2 the canonical permission store.

market.notes: Listings and ownership are relational canonical data; images use object storage.

transport.notes: GTFS/map/public releases can be direct edge reads; private saved routes/alerts remain behind Palta API. Realtime providers stay behind collector/provider adapters.

events_care.notes: Shared lifecycle/Event Core owns durable state; Home and push are projections/delivery choices.

commerce_pos.notes: Integrated online card initiation is blocked when canonical PaymentIntent cannot first be durably created.

payment.notes: Adapters are provider-neutral. Transbank/Mercado Pago exist; Getnet adapter still pending. Provider result unknown blocks blind replacement payment.

fiscal_chile.notes: Payment success is not rolled back solely because SII is unavailable. Fiscal policy decides blocking/deferred behavior.

notifications.notes: Event decision and push delivery are separate; delivery providers are adapters.

map_public_assets.notes: Reuse existing R2/Worker after inventory; do not create duplicate map storage.

media_files.notes: Object URLs do not replace authorization metadata. Private media must not become public merely because it is in R2.
